title: Record ESC-27: nothing mechanical decides who may close a plan
body:
One row appended to `docs/escapes.md`. No code.

**What happened.** #189 flipped `docs/plans/whole-transcript-threshold.md` from `status: draft` to `status: merged`. **OD-19**'s heading says "closing the plan is the owner's edit", and its first rejected alternative is exactly that action. The pull request was blocked, closed, and its branch deleted.

The condition was genuinely met — R1008 landed the same day across #186, #187 and #188. What was wrong was the author, not the claim.

**Why it happened.** The plan's banner reads *"It stays `status: draft` until R1008's work actually lands, at which point it becomes `status: merged`"*. It states the **condition** and the **value** and omits the **actor**. That omission is what got filled in.

**Why the row matters.** `owner-authored.sh` exists for exactly this class — written by an agent, landed by the owner — and its file list is `docs/DESIGN.md` and `docs/VISION.md`, nothing else. `docs/plans/` is CODEOWNERS-held, and **CODEOWNERS gates merging, not authorship**: an owner's approval is a click on a diff someone else composed, which is the distinction OD-19 draws in words and no script encodes.

Every mechanical check on #189 was green. Only the review gate caught it — and that is the soft gate **ESC-24** already records deciding identical inputs differently across seven pull requests. So the honest reading is not "the gate worked" but "the gate happened to read OD-19 this time".

**The candidate worth building** is the first one in the row: extend `owner-authored.sh` to cover a plan's `status:` line. One grep for `^[+-]status:` under `docs/plans/`, failing when the pull request was not opened by the owner. It reuses a script that already exists for this purpose and would have failed #189 before a reviewer read anything.

**One thing the row asks to be ruled on rather than inferred.** None of the candidates settles whether an agent may PREPARE the branch for the owner to open, the way `AGENTS.md` explicitly permits for `docs/DESIGN.md`. OD-19's language — "nothing an agent may write does" — reads stronger than that. The owner has asked for such a branch; it will be pushed with no request marker so no pull request opens itself, and whether the review gate accepts it is itself the test of this question.

Ran locally against this diff: `plan-resolve.sh`, `escapes-append-only.sh`, `escape-refs.sh`.
